_comment: MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE reads a target in its OWN params; with none it takes the untargeted branch and shifts combat.total_defense, i.e. the whole block. 'TARGET <card> gets N{d}' is one card. With a single defender the two agree, which is why this looked right; they part company exactly where the card is restrictive -- a bonus meant for a defending ACTION card applied to a block made entirely of equipment. Same defect fixed on shred_yellow; these are its siblings. Here the target is restricted to a defending ACTION card. Suspense is a printed keyword.
